title: Billionaire hedge fund manager Bill Ackman unveils 6 new stocks he's betting on
excerpt: Pershing Square took new positions in six stocks last quarter, including Netflix and ICE, the owner of the New York Stock Exchange.
content_html:
By Samuel O'Brient

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

Bill Ackman took advantage of the stock market roller coaster ride this summer to add six new stocks to Pershing Square's portfolio last quarter.

In his quarterly letter to investors on the fund's performance, the billionaire hedge fund manager noted that the AI-driven gains year to date have created a "highly attractive environment" to put money to work in other parts of the market. In May, Ackman announced a new investment in Microsoft, flagging it as a major AI winner, but his latest additions are less focused on Big Tech.

Ackman said that the firm is constantly on the lookout for investments that are "simple, predictable, and free cash flow-generative, with strong competitive positions, minimal financial leverage and capital markets dependency, and are run by excellent management teams."

The new investments add to existing positions in companies like Microsoft, Uber, Amazon, and Meta.

Here are the new stocks Ackman added to his fund's portfolio in the second quarter.

Visa and Mastercard

  • Ticker: V and MA
  • Year to date return: +3%, -2%
  • Ackman's Thesis: Ackman sees a valuable buying opportunity in the two leading credit card companies. He said that in his firm's view, Visa and Mastecard are two of the world's highest quality businesses and perfectly fit the Pershing Square Capital criteria.

    "Both are capital light 'toll-takers' that earn a nominal fee on each transaction without taking any material risk and are natural beneficiaries of higher inflation," he said.

Intercontinental Exchange

  • Ticker: ICE
  • Year to date return: -6%
  • Ackman's Thesis: Ackman sees Intercontinental Exchange, the exchange operator that owns of the New York Stock Exchange and other exchanges and clearing houses, as a likely AI beneficiary, as the fast-moving technology continues to drive and reshape securities trading.

    "In ICE we see a classic, simple, predictable, free-cash-flow-generative business that has sold off on concerns we view as unwarranted, a setup that has proven highly profitable for prior Pershing Square investments," he noted.

Netflix

  • Ticker: NFLX
  • Year to date return: -18%
  • Ackman's Thesis: Pershing Square had briefly invested in Netflix in 2022, but Ackman is more bullish now, due to the streaming giant's status as a dominant force in content streaming, even as the stock stumbles in 2026.

    "Netflix has since effectively won the streaming wars," he said. "Its subscriber base now exceeds any competitor's by a wide margin, and that scale is self-reinforcing. Netflix can outspend rivals on content while spreading the cost across the industry's largest user base, improving both the value proposition for subscribers and profitability for the company."

S&P Global

  • Ticker: SPGI
  • Year to date return: -17%
  • Ackman's Thesis: Ackman said that his team has admired the market intelligence company for decades and opted to invest after it fell 25% in the February SaaSpocalypse that was first sparked by new tools from Anthropic and fears of widespread disruption to software makers' businesses.

    "Despite broad-based concerns of AI disintermediation in the company's Market Intelligence segment," he stated, "we believe the market overestimates the portion of segment profits susceptible to AI disruption and 21 underestimates the potential for AI to accelerate demand for S&P's proprietary and curated structured data as LLM-based workflows become increasingly important.

Alcon

  • Ticker: ALC
  • Year to date return: -8%
  • Ackman's Thesis: The eye care company may not be as well known as Pershing Square's other new investments, but Ackman sees significant upside potential due to rising demand for its services fueled by America's aging population, as well as rising incomes. The hedge funder noted that Alcon's earnings have risen at an 8% compounded rate since the company's spin off from Novartis in 2019, and his team maintains that the market is underestimating its growth potential

blocks.html_en: Samuel O'Brient is an experienced financial markets and business journalist who has written extensively on a wide range of topics involving economics, technology and public policy. At Business Insider, he covers important macro and micro economic stories, including takes from leading economists and hedge fund managers, breaking IPOs,  corporate bankruptcies, meme stocks and short-selling. He also writes on other markets such as crypto, oil and real estate.He has interviewed many of the market’s most influential voices, ranging from top economists such as Mark Zandi and Richard Thaler to prominent investors including Danny Moses, Andrew Left, Anthony Scaramucci, Louis Navellier and Grant Cardone.Programs such as LiveNOW from Fox , Taking Stock and Ticker News have had Samuel on to discuss stock market and economic developments. His reporting has been cited by The New York Times DealBook, Bloomberg Radio, Forbes, Entrepreneur, Gizmodo and TheFutureParty.Samuel began at InvestorPlace, covering investing, retail trading and macro economic trends. Prior to joining Business Insider,  he served as a technology markets reporter at TheStreet. He is a graduate of Sarah Lawrence College and Trinity College Dublin.Samuel's work has appeared in publications such as TipRanks, EV and Observer. When he isn't chasing down stories, he can often be found browsing book and record shops. To reach Samuel, email him at sobrient@insider.com or connect with him on LinkedIn. He is also on Signal as Samuel Clemens.

content_html_zh:
作者：Samuel O'Brient 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。

比尔·阿克曼（Bill Ackman）利用今年夏天股市过山车的机会，上季度向潘兴广场（Pershing Square）的投资组合添加了六只新股票。

这位亿万富翁对冲基金经理在致投资者关于基金业绩的季度信中指出，今年以来人工智能驱动的收益创造了一个“极具吸引力的环境”，可以将资金投入到市场的其他领域。 五月，阿克曼宣布对微软进行新投资，将其标记为人工智能的主要赢家，但他最新的投资不太关注大型科技公司。

阿克曼表示，该公司一直在寻找“简单、可预测、能产生自由现金流、具有强大竞争地位、最小的财务杠杆和资本市场依赖，并由优秀管理团队运营的投资”。

新投资增加了微软、Uber、亚马逊和 Meta 等公司的现有职位。

以下是阿克曼第二季度添加到其基金投资组合中的新股票。

维萨卡和万事达卡

  • 股票代码：V 和 MA
  • 年初至今回报率：+3%、-2%
  • 阿克曼的论文：阿克曼在两家领先的信用卡公司中看到了宝贵的购买机会。 他表示，在他的公司看来，Visa和Mastecard是全球质量最高的两家企业，完全符合潘兴广场资本的标准。“两家公司都是轻资本‘收费者’，在每笔交易中赚取象征性的费用，而不承担任何实质性风险，是通胀上升的天然受益者，”他说。

洲际交易所

  • 代码： ICE
  • 年初至今回报率：-6%
  • 阿克曼的论文：阿克曼将洲际交易所（拥有纽约证券交易所和其他交易所和清算所的交易所运营商）视为可能的人工智能受益者，因为快速发展的技术继续推动和重塑证券交易。“在 ICE，我们看到了一个经典的、简单的、可预测的、自由现金流生成的业务，它因我们认为毫无根据的担忧而被抛售，事实证明，这种设置对于之前的潘兴广场来说是高利润的。”投资，”他指出。

Netflix

  • 代码： NFLX
  • 年初至今回报率：-18%
  • 阿克曼的论点：潘兴广场曾在 2022 年短暂投资过 Netflix，但阿克曼现在更加看好这家流媒体巨头作为内容流媒体主导力量的地位，尽管该股在 2026 年表现不佳。 “自那以后，Netflix 实际上赢得了流媒体战争，”他说。 “它的用户群现在远远超过任何竞争对手，而且这种规模正在自我增强。 Netflix 可以在内容上超越竞争对手，同时将成本分摊到业内最大的用户群，从而提高订户的价值主张和公司的盈利能力。”

标准普尔全球

  • 代码： SPGI
  • 年初至今回报率：-17%
  • 阿克曼的论文：阿克曼表示，他的团队几十年来一直钦佩这家市场情报公司，并在 2 月份 SaaS 末日下跌 25% 后选择了投资，这次灾难最初是由 Anthropic 的新工具和对软件制造商业务广泛中断的担忧引发的。随着基于法学硕士的工作流程变得越来越重要，21 低估了人工智能加速对标准普尔专有和精选结构化数据的需求的潜力。

Alcon

  • 代码： ALC
  • 年初至今回报率：-8%
  • 阿克曼的论点：这家眼科护理公司可能不如潘兴广场的其他新投资那么出名，但阿克曼认为，由于美国人口老龄化以及收入增加，对其服务的需求不断增长，该公司具有巨大的上升潜力。 这位对冲基金人士指出，自 2019 年该公司从诺华分拆以来，爱尔康的盈利复合增长率为 8%，他的团队坚持认为市场低估了其增长潜力

塞缪尔·奥布莱恩 (Samuel O'Brient) 是一位经验丰富的金融市场和商业记者，撰写的文章涉及经济、技术和公共政策等广泛主题。 在《商业内幕》中，他报道了重要的宏观和微观经济故事，包括顶尖经济学家和对冲基金经理的观点、首次公开募股失败、企业破产、迷因股票和卖空。 他还撰写有关加密货币、石油和房地产等其他市场的文章。他采访了许多市场上最有影响力的声音，从马克·赞迪和理查德·塞勒等顶级经济学家到丹尼·摩西、安德鲁·莱夫特、安东尼·斯卡拉穆奇、路易斯·纳维利尔和格兰特·卡登等著名投资者。福克斯的 LiveNOW、Taking Stock 和 Ticker News 等节目让塞缪尔讨论股市和经济发展。 他的报道曾被纽约时报 DealBook、彭博电台、福布斯、Entrepreneur、Gizmodo 和 TheFutureParty 引用。Samuel 最初在 InvestorPlace 工作，报道投资、零售交易和宏观经济趋势。 在加入 Business Insider 之前，他曾担任 TheStreet 的技术市场记者。 他毕业于莎拉·劳伦斯学院和都柏林三一学院。Samuel 的作品曾发表在 TipRanks、EV 和 Observer 等出版物上。 当他不追寻故事时，人们经常会发现他在逛书店和唱片店。 要联系 Samuel，请发送电子邮件至 sobrient@insider.com 或通过 LinkedIn 与他联系。 他还在《信号》中饰演塞缪尔·克莱门斯。
